content.title: Where to watch Duke vs. St. John’s Sweet 16 matchup for free without cable tonight
content.text: Updated: Mar. 27, 2026, 5:01 p.m.Published: Mar. 27, 2026, 5:00 p.m.Duke forward Cameron Boozer (12) reacts after scoring during the second half in the second round of the NCAA college basketball tournament against TCU, Saturday, March 21, 2026, in Greenville, S.C.(AP Photo/Brynn Anderson)If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe No. 1 Duke Blue Devils and the No. 5 St. John’s Red Storm will face off tonight in the Sweet 16.Fans can catch the game on CBS at 7:10 p.m. ET, with streaming options available through Fubo, DirecTV Stream and Paramount+. Sweet 16 Streaming OptionsTable not scrollableFubo: Fubo’s Pro plan comes with 212 channels, including CBS, for $73.99 per month. New subscribers can start with a free trial and score $25 off the first month of their subscription.DirecTV Stream: DirecTV Stream’s Pro plan is available for $94.99 per month and comes with over 90 channels including CBS. New customers can start with a five-day free trial and take $35 off their first month. Paramount+: New and returning subscribers can get two months of Paramount+ for just $2.99 per month from now until March 31. The winner of tonight’s game will advance to the Elite Eight to play the winner of No. 2 UConn and No. 3 Michigan State.
